info.name: Barber Booking API
info.description: Requests mirror the implemented API. Set baseUrl to the API prefix, then run USER and BARBER registration/login requests to populate role tokens. Create a barber profile, services and working hours before attempting booking; a booking also needs a future startAt within configured opening hours. Use IDs from responses in collection variables. This collection calls only the HTTP API and never accesses a database directly. Password variables are blank placeholders only; use disposable development accounts and do not export populated environments.

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', body.data.accessToken); if (body.data?.user?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', body.data.user.id);

const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('barberToken', body.data.accessToken); if (body.data?.user?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('barberUserId', body.data.user.id);
const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('userToken', body.data.accessToken);
const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.accessToken) pm.collectionVariables.set('barberToken', body.data.accessToken);

item.name: Get public barber profile (optional USER auth)

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('barberId', body.data.id);
const body = pm.response.json(); if (body.data?.id) pm.collectionVariables.set('serviceId', body.data.id);
